name: native-migration

classification.use_for: Electron to native planning and implementation

rules: Keep production Electron operational until per-OS acceptance passes.
Use SwiftUI/AppKit and Qt/QML as proposed targets; validate Rust bridge before commitment.
Never share writable storage between old and new runtimes.
Task identity, cancellation, recovery and credentials follow architecture contract.
Figma approval is separate from runtime and release acceptance.
Mobile remains plan-only unless explicitly requested.
